agents.summary: Tracks job invoices and materials cost, and chases what hasn't been paid.
does: Keep a running list of jobs invoiced and paid
Flag jobs that were finished but never invoiced
Track what you spend on materials and parts
Send a weekly money summary
wontDo: Send a customer an invoice or a reminder without asking
Move money or pay a supplier
agents.firstAction: Oscar sends your first money summary next Monday at 9am

agents.summary: Keeps an eye on your email and job calendar, routes each message to the right person, and tells you the night before what's booked.
does: Sort new mail into job requests, suppliers, invoices and junk
Keep the job calendar current, and tell you the night before what's booked and where
Flag two jobs booked too close together to both make
Route quote requests to Kelly and bills to Oscar
wontDo: Reply on your behalf without asking
agents.firstAction: Pam reads you tomorrow's jobs tonight at 6pm

agents.summary: Answers quote requests, follows up on quotes, and asks for a review after a job.
does: Draft replies to quote requests using your rates and your charge for a visit
Draft a reminder when a quote has gone quiet
Draft a review request after a job is done
Ask you before committing to a price or a date
agents.firstAction: Kelly replies when a quote request arrives

agents.summary: Turns single jobs into repeat business: sells maintenance plans, follows up on big quotes, and tracks your sales each month.
does: Keep a list of customers due for a maintenance visit, and draft the offer
Follow up on large quotes that have gone quiet
Track sales against your monthly target
wontDo: Send a quote or offer a discount without your OK
agents.firstAction: Dwight asks which customers are due for a service tomorrow at 9am

agents.summary: Keeps track of parts and supplies on the van and in storage, and tells you what to restock before a job.
does: Keep counts of the parts and supplies you carry
Check tomorrow's jobs against what's on the van, and flag what's missing
Keep a restock list ready for your next supply run
agents.firstAction: Darryl asks what's on your van tomorrow at 9am

agents.summary: Looks after your suppliers: parts orders, price changes, and deliveries that run late.
does: Keep a list of your suppliers and what you buy from each
Draft parts orders from Darryl's restock list
Flag price rises and late deliveries
wontDo: Place an order without your OK
agents.firstAction: Meredith asks who your suppliers are tomorrow at 9am

agents.summary: Drafts seasonal service reminders and local posts for the work you want more of.
does: Draft seasonal reminders your customers should hear about
Draft posts about jobs you tell him about
Write in your voice, not a brochure's
wontDo: Post anything before you approve it
agents.firstAction: Ryan drafts this season's service reminder on Monday at 9am
